messages:
jordan_acme: Hey team — invoice this month jumped ~600k tokens vs our local estimator. Dashboard shows ~1.2M but invoice 1.8M. No big usage change on our side.
Lina Support: Hi @jordan_acme — sorry about the surprise. Can you share a minimal repro (curl/sdk) and whether you used streaming or function/tool calls? :mag:
jordan_acme: Quick repro attached, we call a chat completion with a small system + user message then stream. Local SDK estimator = 1,210,432 tokens. Invoice shows 1,806,001. Curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{
  "model": "open-rlhf-small",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Summarize this doc."}
  ],
  "stream": true
}'
```
We also have a sidecar that adds an auth header and an `x-client-meta` JSON blob server-side.
Megan (DevEx): Thanks, Jordan. Can you confirm whether the sidecar injects any extra messages (system/tool) in-flight? Also, which SDK version? We recently changed streaming sentinel behavior in 2.4.0.
jordan_acme: Sidecar does add header `x-prefill` with base64 metadata. No explicit extra messages from our app. SDK v2.4.0.
Megan (DevEx): Ok — this looks like the streaming prefill path plus server-inserted KV metadata causing tokenization differences. Repro steps I suggest:
1) Run curl without sidecar -> note estimator vs invoice.
2) Run with sidecar header `x-prefill` -> compare.
3) Try disabling stream to see if boundary handling affects counts.
Quick note: we saw a case where the runtime inserts a small JSON blob as an auxiliary tool_response for telemetry; that blob is counted in server-side tokenization but client estimators often ignore header-prefill or server-inserted tool payloads.
Ravi (Billing): If the server is adding bytes that get tokenized we need to know whether metering attributes mark them as billable. Billing policy currently bills everything consumed by the model, including server-injected tokens unless marked non-billable.
metering-bot: Incident-detect: potential-metering-delta - flagged 4132101110 - tags: streaming, sidecar, server-prefill
Lina Support: Can you run the two quick repro commands and paste the raw request/response bodies (no keys) so we can see exact bytes? Also share a snippet of the `x-prefill` value.
jordan_acme: Pasted sanitized payload: `x-prefill: eyJrdiI6eyJ1aWQiOiJhY2...."` — when I base64-decode it's a 600-byte JSON with client metadata. Running without header drops invoice by ~580 tokens.
Megan (DevEx): That matches a hypothesis: base64-decoded metadata is being injected into the model payload as an auxiliary context (e.g., runtime attaches as `tool` message or hidden system content) and counted server-side. Two mitigations:
- Short-term: Strip/limit `x-prefill` in sidecar or mark metadata in a separate non-tokenized header/path (we can recommend a header change).
- Medium-term: Update SDK estimator to include a config toggle to simulate server-prefill tokens for more accurate local estimates.
- Long-term: Mark runtime-injected telemetry as non-billable metadata in metering pipeline (requires policy + engineering change).
Ravi (Billing): For this customer we can do a one-time invoice adjustment while we investigate if the injected bytes are purely telemetry. Need confirmation from infra/runtime.
Megan (DevEx): I'll open an infra ticket with logs and tagging: runtime may have added `aux_payload` at request acceptance. @infra-team please check request 4132101110 for any server-inserted messages or toolcall payloads.
Lina Support: Jordan — interim ask: please disable the sidecar header and re-run a small batch; we'll compare traces and if confirmed we'll submit a credit and follow up.
jordan_acme: Done — re-ran 50 requests, dashboard vs invoice aligned within noise. Thanks, that narrows it. Appreciate fast response.
Megan (DevEx): Filing follow-up: INFRA-7889 (check runtime prefill injection) and BILL-1254 (possible credit for 4132101110). Will update thread when infra confirms.
Ravi (Billing): Once infra confirms non-user telemetry injection we'll apply pro-rated credit and update billing docs to clarify what counts. :+1:
Lina Support: Great. Closing loop once infra answers. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
